local_reimplementations.name: ProductCard
local_reimplementations.notes: card-grid row renderer for the product catalog: image, name, manufacturer, SKU, condition badge, NuxtLink row-link to /products/[slug]. Used by products/index.vue and products/category/[slug].vue.

local_reimplementations.name: products/index.vue catalog logic
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled server-paginated/filtered/sorted/searchable product catalog: state refs, useFetch with query params, URL sync (updateUrl), mobile filter drawer, active-filter chips, prev/next pagination.

local_reimplementations.name: products/category/[slug].vue catalog logic
local_reimplementations.notes: near-duplicate of products/index.vue's fetch/pagination/grid logic scoped to one category; same totalPages/currentPage/grid-cols pattern copy-pasted rather than shared.

local_reimplementations.name: EquipmentPage
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled marketing page template (breadcrumb + hero + content sections) reused across /equipment/* pages; a page_header/section_header-style pattern, not table-related.

local_reimplementations.name: IndustryPage
local_reimplementations.notes: same marketing page-template pattern as EquipmentPage, reused across /industries/* pages.

table.server_api: apps/web/server/api/products.get.ts (params: category, subcategory, manufacturer, voltage, amperage, search, page, limit, sort)

pagination_control.notes: prev/next buttons + 'Page X of Y' text, no page-number list, no page-size selector; duplicated (not shared) in category/[slug].vue

sort_control.notes: native <select v-model="activeSort"> (name-asc/name-desc/newest/manufacturer), not a Nuxt UI component

filter_search_bar.notes: search input + category/subcategory/manufacturer/voltage/amperage filters, mobile slide-over drawer, active-filter chip row

status_chip_badge.notes: condition badge (new/reconditioned) pill on product card image

empty_state.notes: 'No products found' block, duplicated in category page

loading_skeleton.notes: grid of placeholder divs shown while status === 'pending'

page_header.notes: breadcrumb+hero+content template for equipment landing pages
same pattern for industry landing pages

auth_gating_ui.notes: legacy template-layer auth component copied into app/components (not measured further); AuthRegisterCard.vue, AuthExchangePanel.vue also present

defect_history.summary: Unguarded JSON.parse on product images/tags columns crashes product API responses
Template-layer exit onto narduk-libs (harmony#87 pattern) — web foundation contract §4

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionTable / ProductCatalogGrid
top_extraction_candidates.why: server-paginated, filtered, sorted, searchable, URL-synced list pattern duplicated near-verbatim across two pages (mobile drawer, filter chips, prev/next pager, loading/empty states all copy-pasted); confirmed server list contract already exists (products.get.ts) to build a shared table/grid against

top_extraction_candidates.name: MarketingPageTemplate
top_extraction_candidates.why: two near-identical hand-rolled breadcrumb+hero+content templates reused across 12 landing pages

notes: Zero narduk-libs UI adoption; still on narduk-nuxt-template-layer-* (legacy). Issue #38 shows Logan already has an open 'template-layer exit onto narduk-libs' ticket for this app, and #22 documents a live data-shape bug in the exact server list contract a shared table would need to wrap defensively (images/tags JSON columns). No dedicated tests exist for the catalog's pagination/filter/sort behavior.
